scripts.build: pnpm run build:docx-editor && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter docx-sidecar run build
scripts.build:docx-editor: pnpm --filter @docx-editor.dev/i18n run build && pnpm --filter @docx-editor.dev/core run build && pnpm --filter @docx-editor.dev/react run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./packages/*" --filter docx-sidecar run --if-present typecheck && uv run pyright
